name: arch-linux-pkgbuild
reason: Selected as the base so linux-rg stays close to Arch package hooks, pacman ownership, mkinitcpio behavior, DKMS headers, and rEFInd expectations on this machine.

name: bore
reason: Selected as the single fair-class scheduler patch because it is a focused 7.0 scheduler patch and fits the desktop-latency goal without importing the full CachyOS kernel.

name: bbr3
reason: Selected as the carried TCP lane in linux-rg through the adapted 0003/0004/0017 patch set.

name: adios
reason: Selected as a non-default mq scheduler module for local NVMe A/B tests.

name: cachy-memory-ratios
reason: Selected as the carried anon/clean working-set protection knobs in 0018.

name: mglru-devtree
reason: Selected as the carried MGLRU dev-tree weld in 0019.

name: cache-aware-sched
reason: Selected as the carried CONFIG_SCHED_CACHE placement experiment in 0020.

name: mm-bulk-free-hotpaths
reason: Selected as the carried cachyos-fixes #16-17 bulk-free pair in 0021.

name: linux-zen-release-patch
reason: Surveyed as an alternate downstream release patch. It is not overlaid with the Arch release patch because both patch the same kernel release integration layer.

name: liquorix
reason: Surveyed for desktop latency defaults. Not imported wholesale because its published tuning explicitly trades throughput and power usage for responsiveness, which is not the default laptop battery target.

name: psi-oomd
reason: Selected as kernel PSI plus a host oomd profile so userspace pressure recovery can act before the kernel OOM path dominates the laptop.

name: mglru
reason: Selected because upstream documents Multi-Gen LRU as improving reclaim and memory-pressure behavior; this fits the 30 GiB mobile workstation profile.

name: sched-ext
reason: Selected as a runtime scheduler experimentation surface with upstream fallback semantics when a BPF scheduler errors or stalls.

name: eevdf
reason: Selected as the mainline fair-class baseline used for comparison and fallback; it remains present under the BORE patch path.

name: bfq
reason: Selected as an available I/O scheduler for cgroup-aware desktop workloads. It is not forced as the NVMe default because mq-deadline/none remain better baselines for this PCIe SSD.

name: ck-muqss
reason: Disabled because CK/MuQSS is not maintained against this kernel series and conflicts with the current fair-class, EEVDF, and BORE scheduler path.

name: bmq-pds-prjc
reason: Disabled because Project C schedulers are mutually exclusive with BORE. A separate experimental package can test them, but linux-rg selects one scheduler patch.

name: liquorix-wholesale
reason: Disabled because the host profile needs battery-aware defaults, not an unconditional low-latency desktop stack.

name: cachyos-wholesale
reason: Disabled because linux-rg should be hardware-specific instead of a renamed CachyOS package. CachyOS remains a patch source where individual patches apply.
